manuscript_alignment: pending: exact accepted manuscript is not available locally

claims.statement: Corrected opt-in FFN has a small M=129 gain; M=257 is inconclusive.
claims.scope: September uninstrumented campaigns. Model/policy fixed; below 1.05x automatic promotion gate. Original shortened-stride measurements are invalid.

claims.statement: Measured complete FFN critical path is CPU dominated.
claims.scope: Instrumented diagnostics; overlapping branch durations must not be added; does not replace historical headline timing. Two V3D MMU events are retained in campaign qualifications.

claims.statement: Six-cell split screen contains no promoted policy. Consists of 4 inconclusive cases and 2 losses under its stated CI classification.
claims.scope: Exploratory screen, not independent confirmation or proof that 1/8 is optimal.

claims.statement: Serialization is slower; copy/materialization effects span parity.
claims.scope: Five matched process blocks; all four variants have identical complete candidate logits; effects are not additive.

claims.statement: Production MTP QPU hook is slower than CPU_REPACK.
claims.scope: M=1 K=256 N=2048, real weights and activation; wait is observable host interval, not isolated device arithmetic.

claims.statement: Host preparation dominates current pointwise and dense 3x3 W8A8 convolution.
claims.scope: Prepared steady state; Torch FP32 baseline changes representation. Pointwise is GEMM-backed; dense 3x3 uses im2col. Depthwise attempts are rejected, not accepted timing evidence.

claims.statement: Matched fused Torch bias+ReLU is faster than QPU. Optimized same-contract CPU W8A8 control unavailable.
claims.scope: Historical 1.920x stage result compares against NumPy two passes; this control does not show a fused-CPU win for QPU. TODO6(a) remains omitted.

claims.statement: One-input complete ResNet-18 QPU execution is slower; FP32 logit checks pass.
claims.scope: Full preprocessed 1x3x224x224 input to logits; 128-pixel source derivative; no new task accuracy, VLA latency or energy result.

claims.statement: Projection campaign has 112 configurations, ten median-rule wins. Six-worker min/max selector is an implementation cutoff.
claims.scope: No historical confidence-interval classification or optimal-worker claim; separate role reruns and stage sweeps excluded.

claims.statement: MMLU/ResNet FP32/YOLO FP32 qualifications; ResNet W8A8 regression and SmolVLA gate/stability failures.
claims.scope: Reports valid_run attests execution only. SmolVLA 1.56% NRMSE/cosine 0.999881 misses FP32 gates; resets/resumes do not establish reliability. COCO bootstrap omitted in retained campaign.

claims.statement: Attribution and scope corrections prepared; manuscript and publication unverified.
